method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. The first encoding of the Regulations; the Fair Work Act 2009 encodings are unchanged. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fair Work Regulations 2009 (F2009L02356), Compilation No. 57, compilation date 1 October 2026 (register id F2026C00996), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/F2009L02356.txt; Fair Work Act 2009 ss 333F(1)(e), (2), 382(b)(iii), 527F(3), Compilation No. 73 (C2026C00355), as deposited at ../../../fair-work-act-2009/registers/source-bundle/C2009A00028.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual bringing or weighing an employment claim: the employee checking deductions and pay slips, the dismissed employee (high income threshold, compensation cap, absence through illness or injury), the fixed term employee, the applicant to the Fair Work Commission (fees, hardship, refund), the defence member harassed at work, the small claims plaintiff, the deactivated or terminated regulated worker

fwr-pay.l4: Does my deduction authorisation include what is required
Is the deduction reasonable under the regulations
Can my employer claim to offset my casual loading
Does my pay slip show the basic details
Does my pay slip show my deductions and rate
Does my pay slip show my super
Does my pay slip wrongly show family and domestic violence leave
fwr-threshold.l4: What is this year's high income threshold
What was the 2009-10 high income threshold
What was the 2024-25 contractor high income threshold
What is this year's contractor high income threshold
Am I under the high income threshold
How much remuneration am I taken to have received
fwr-fixed-term.l4: What is my fixed term contract's high income threshold
Am I above the high income threshold for my fixed term contract
Is my sport contract outside the limits
Is my international event contract outside the limits
Is my charity project contract outside the limits
Is my research project contract outside the limits
fwr-claims.l4: Is my conduct an example of serious misconduct
Was my illness or injury protected under s 352
Was my illness or injury protected under s 772
What was the starting application fee
What is this year's application fee
How much application fee must I pay
How much fee must be repaid
Can I apply for a stop sexual harassment order as a defence member
Have I asked for the small claims procedure properly
Can an industrial association official represent me
Are my other services contract proceedings specified
the FWC's duty to repay the fee

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fwr-pay-cases.l4; l4 run fwr-threshold-cases.l4; l4 run fwr-fixed-term-cases.l4; l4 run fwr-claims-cases.l4; l4 run on each module
checks.result: fwr-pay-cases.l4 35 of 35; fwr-threshold-cases.l4 27 of 27; fwr-fixed-term-cases.l4 35 of 35; fwr-claims-cases.l4 81 of 81; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A negative control (three altered expected values) gave three failures.

scope: In: regs 1.07, 1.08AA, 2.03A, 2.12A, 2.12, 2.13, 2.14, 2.15 (1)-(4), (7)-(9A), 3.01, 3.02, 3.03, 3.05, 3.06, 3.07, 3.29A, 3.45-3.48, 3A.03, 3A.05, 4.01, 6.01A, 6.01B, 6.01C, 6.04, 6.05, 6.07A, with the Act's comparisons in ss 333F(1)(e) and 382(b)(iii). Out: Schedule 3.1 and regs 3.04, 3.08, 3A.04, 6.06 (costs tariff); regs 3.31-3.44 (employee records); reg 7.06 and Chapter 7; Parts 1-2 (other than regs 1.07, 1.08AA), 1-3 (read for terms only); reg 2.00 (parental leave days); reg 4.01A (remedies for out-of-scope ballot and records duties); Parts 2-2, 2-4, 3-3, 3-4, Chapters 3A-3B orders, Part 4-1 Division 4, Chapter 5, Parts 6-2, 6-3, 6-3A, 6-4C to 6-4DA; regs 3.30, 6.07 (forms); the CPI indexation formula and reg 3.05(4)(b), (5) formulas, lost from the deposited text (inputs).
